sentence: This project studies how the design and additive manufacturing of metallic structures change their defects, elastic strain limit and fatigue resistance.
This project studies how the parts of a synthetic receptor on T cells tune the way the T cells respond to cancer cells.
This project measures aerosols and low-level clouds in Antarctica to help improve climate model simulations.
This project builds a short online course that teaches ocean researchers how to find, access and reuse large ocean data.
This project studies how growing stem cells in confined shapes changes the beating cardiac organoids they form.
This project designs high frequency radar and communication systems by considering electrical, mechanical and thermal design together.
This project builds a chip that copies the barrier between blood and the spinal cord using human stem cells, to study how it forms.
This project builds faster and more precise ways to measure yield and quality traits in tomato, onion and strawberry using imaging and machine learning.
This project builds a material from decellularized plant leaves that human stem cells can grow on.
This project studies which genes build the segments of annelid worms and how resource availability affects the adding of segments.
This project studies how single DNA molecules on a surface interact with other molecules, using scanning electrochemical cell microscopy.
This project studies how yeast cells sense and control their size and how size changes what the cells do.
This project builds AI methods that improve how neutrinos are reconstructed from the sensor data of a detector.
This project studies how the atoms in metallic glasses are arranged and how that arrangement makes parts of the material soften under force.
This project studies how differences in the brain clock neurons of Drosophila lead to differences in sleep and wake cycles between males and females.
This project builds a handheld system that tracks inventory in retail stores using radio frequency identification and computer vision.
This project designs ways to filter out noise from quantum computer data so that simulations of molecules and solids are more accurate.
This project builds tiny robots that use magnetic fields for power and on-board electronics to control their swimming.
